choose.when:
<set-variable name="rdwrRespSample" value="@{
          if ((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrOopLog", "") != "3") { return false; }
          long declared = (long)context.Variables["rdwrRespDeclaredLength"];
          long maxBody = (long)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrBodyMaxSize", 100000L);
          return declared > 0 && declared <= maxBody;
        }" />
        
          @{
            var ep_addr = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrAppEpAddr", "");
            var ep_port = (int)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrAppEpPort", 443);
            var ep_ssl = (bool)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrAppEpSsl", true);
            var scheme = ep_ssl ? "https" : "http";
            var path = context.Request.OriginalUrl.Path;
            return $"{scheme}://{ep_addr}:{ep_port}{path}";
          }
          POST
          
            @((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrTrueHost", ""))
          
          
          
            2
          
          
            log
          
          
            @((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pluginInfo", "700-v1.5.0"))
          
          
            @((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrAppId", ""))
          
          
            @((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrApiKey", ""))
          
          
            @((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrOopId", ""))
          
          
          
            @(context.Response.StatusCode.ToString())
          
          
            @(Math.Max(0L, (long)context.Variables["rdwrRespDeclaredLength"]).ToString())
          
          
            @{
              // bytes-sent = status line (~20 bytes) + serialized response
              // headers ("name: value\r\n" each) + final empty line (2 bytes) + body
              try {
                long bodyLen = Math.Max(0L, (long)context.Variables["rdwrRespDeclaredLength"]);
                long headerBytes = 0;
                if (context.Response.Headers != null) {
                  foreach (var h in context.Response.Headers) {
                    string name = h.Key ?? "";
                    string val = string.Join(", ", h.Value ?? new string[0]);
                    headerBytes += name.Length + 2 + val.Length + 2; // ": " + "\r\n"
                  }
                }
                const int statusLine = 20;
                const int finalCrlf = 2;
                return (statusLine + headerBytes + finalCrlf + bodyLen).ToString();
              } catch { return "0"; }
            }
          
          
            @{
              var start = (DateTime)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestStartTime", DateTime.UtcNow);
              return (DateTime.UtcNow - start).TotalSeconds.ToString("F3");
            }
          
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Type", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Server", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Set-Cookie", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Cache-Control", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Security-Policy", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Referrer-Policy", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Strict-Transport-Security", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Permissions-Policy", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Frame-Options", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Content-Type-Options", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Backend-Server", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-Runtime", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-CF-Powered-By", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-AspNet-Version", ""))
          
          
            allowed
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Transfer-Encoding", ""))
          
          
            @(context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Encoding", ""))
          
          
          
            application/octet-stream
          
          
            base64
          
          @{
            if ((bool)context.Variables["rdwrRespSample"]) {
              try {
                var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                if (body != null && body.Length > 0) {
                  // sample size requested by SecurePath ("2k", "1m" or a number of bytes), within
                  // 1 .. rdwr-body-max-size-bytes; an unreadable value means the 2 KB default
                  long limit = 2048;
                  string limitStr = ((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrOopLogBody", "2k") ?? "").Trim().ToLower();
                  long unit = limitStr.EndsWith("k") ? 1024L : limitStr.EndsWith("m") ? 1048576L : 1L;
                  long n;
                  if (long.TryParse(unit == 1L ? limitStr : limitStr.Substring(0, limitStr.Length - 1), out n) && n > 0 && n <= 1073741824L) { limit = n * unit; }
                  long maxBody = (long)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rdwrBodyMaxSize", 100000L);
                  if (limit > maxBody) { limit = maxBody; }
                  if (limit < 1) { limit = 1; }
                  byte[] capture;
                  if (body.Length > limit) {
                    capture = new byte[(int)limit];
                    System.Array.Copy(body, capture, (int)limit);
                  } else {
                    capture = body;
                  }
                  return Convert.ToBase64String(capture);
                }
              } catch { }
            }
            return "";
          }
